conversations.title: Wheelchair bar row not uncommon, Coronation Street star says
conversations.reply: That must've been really frustrating for Cherylee Houston, and sadly it's something lots of people can relate to. Hope her speaking out makes a difference.

conversations.title: 'I was kicked out of bar because of my wheelchair'
conversations.reply: Maddie Haining's experience is appalling, and it's shocking that some venues still don't get it. Being turned away because of your wheelchair is just not on.

conversations.title: These LGBT People Say They Feel Shut Out Of The Scene Because They Are Disabled
conversations.reply: Reece Maycock's story really hits home, doesn't it? It's sad that some LGBT spaces are just as inaccessible as the rest of the world, but hopefully, we can change that.

conversations.title: Letters: Businesses should improve access for people with disabilities
conversations.reply: I totally agree with this letter - it's just common sense that businesses should make their spaces accessible to everyone, and it's not just about the law, it's about being decent.

conversations.title: July is Disability Pride month
conversations.reply: July is a great time to celebrate who we are and I'm so glad we have a whole month to do it, hope the positivity keeps going all year.

conversations.title: Molly Burke - Wikipedia
conversations.reply: Molly Burke's work is amazing, and she's using her platform to make a real impact - I love seeing her creativity and advocacy in action.

conversations.title: About ,  Molly Burke Official
conversations.reply: Molly Burke's story is so refreshing - she's a great example of how disability is just a natural part of human diversity, and I'm a big fan of her work.

conversations.title: Avoid this one dating habit that has 'zero ability to predict if a relationship will be happy or stable,' says relationship coach
conversations.reply: I think this relationship coach is spot on - focusing on the wrong things can lead to disappointment, and it's all about building genuine connections and valuing each other's characters.
